semantic.justification: TaskBG0GG5 ports actual ScUndoSetCell maPos/maOldValue/maNewValue move ownership,represented SetValue,GetComment and getAffectedRange at native source/header boundaries. ScCellValue.release transfers real formulas without cloning and copies literal strings before clearing ownership. Shared SfxListUndoAction exposes native inherited SfxUndoArray.GetUndoAction forward-storage access. The browser current plain-input decoder prepares actual native cell/formula owners at each selected sheet position before writes;source selected-mark iteration uses existing EnterListAction/LeaveListAction so one user input creates one compound action. Undo reverses children,Redo forwards them;browser focus follows the last executed native affected range. Native selected sheets render Writer indigo/slate selection tokens while active state remains distinct. Full ScSimpleUndo,ScDocFunc/ScViewFunc,ScUndoEnterData raw-string redo,formatter/format attributes,change tracking,sheet views,spill/VCL services remain unported;no facade or injected fake provider is introduced.
